intro:
THIS IS A SETUP GUIDE.
Another World is not
included in this pack.
You are walking through
how to install your own
copy on CHGame.

Five stations trace the
journey: buy, find the
files, build, then copy
to your SD card.
These actions are a
rehearsal. Use a real PC.

LEFT / RIGHT: walk
UP or B: jump
A: read a station / next
START: pause / menu

Walk to the lit beacon.

stations.heading: 1/5  THE ARRIVAL
pages:
The beacon marks the
start of your journey.
This little adventure
explains how to replace
it with Another World
on your handheld.

On a real computer:
Buy and install the game
from Steam. It includes
the Amiga disk files
needed by our patcher.
Head right to the shop.

stations.heading: 2/5  THE TERMINAL
pages:
ON YOUR COMPUTER
Open the Steam store.
Find Another World -
20th Anniversary Edition.
Its Steam app ID is
233550.

Buy the game to support
its creators. Already
own it? Open your Steam
Library instead. Select
Another World, INSTALL,
and finish the download.

This terminal cannot
buy or download anything.
Do those steps on your
computer. The light here
only marks a guide step.
Next: find the disks.

stations.heading: 3/5  THE ARCHIVE
pages:
IN YOUR STEAM LIBRARY
Select Another World.
Choose MANAGE, then
BROWSE LOCAL FILES.
This opens the installed
game folder on your PC.

Open these subfolders:
Bonus
rom Amiga

Find the two .adf files:
DiskA and DiskB.

Keep BOTH disk files.
These are the original
Amiga game data, not
programming source code.
The patcher can find them
from the Steam folder.

The crate holds 2 disks.
Carry them to the press.
In real life, leave the
Steam files in place:
the patcher reads them
and makes a new copy.

stations.heading: 4/5  THE WORKSHOP
pages:
ON YOUR WINDOWS PC
Get the Windows patcher
from our GitHub releases:
github.com/bateske/
OtherRealm/releases
Extract the whole ZIP.

Open this program:
Otherrealm-Patcher.exe

Choose your Steam game
folder, or its folder
Bonus/rom Amiga.

Choose a NEW, EMPTY
output folder. Click
BUILD MY CARTRIDGE.
Wait for all five steps
to finish successfully.
Your source stays intact.

The output includes:
Otherrealm.chgame
sdcard-rev0/
sdcard-rev1/
Choose the folder for
your board at the dock.

stations.heading: 5/5  THE CARD DOCK
pages:
ON YOUR COMPUTER
Insert your CHGame SD
card in a card reader.
Use a FAT16/FAT32 card.
Back up its old game
files before replacing.

Rev 0: sdcard-rev0/
Rev 1: sdcard-rev1/
Copy contents to SD ROOT:
OTHERWRL.PAK
GAMES/OTHERREA.CHG
Not in an sdcard folder.

For a card with several
games, use CHGame tools
to import the generated
Otherrealm.chgame into
the collection. This
preserves its game menu.

Safely eject the card.
Insert it into CHGame.
Select OTHER REALM.
Your new OTHERWRL.PAK
replaces this guide with
Another World. Go right.

ending:
GUIDE COMPLETE
No files were installed
by playing this guide.
On your PC: buy, install,
find the disks, patch,
then copy to the card.

Your card should have:
OTHERWRL.PAK
GAMES/OTHERREA.CHG
Safely eject, insert,
and launch OTHER REALM.
A: return to the dock.
